Nashik Court Grants Bail in TCS Case Involving Allegations

A Nashik Sessions Court has granted bail to Nida Khan, an accused in a case involving allegations of religious conversion and sexual harassment linked to a TCS-associated BPO unit in Nashik. Another co-accused also received bail. The case details and the court's reasoning for granting bail were not specified in the provided coverage.
